status: exploratory, on data already seen by #386; not a test and not a confirmation

reproduction.note: Rebuilt from the published observation file, not #386's private rows. Three Windermere and Frensham points use the bathing water's 300 m core here, not the WQA point's own.

within_season.note: Each pair minus its lake-season mean of index and log10 lab value, so lake level and the season's level are removed; only change inside a season is left. Lake-seasons with one pair drop out. The shallow/deeper split is #386's, stated before its run; neither group is a lead finding here.

calendar.note: Changes between two different months only. The calendar guess uses other lakes' monthly means of log10 lab chlorophyll from the same pairs.

direction.note: Consecutive pairs at one lake in one season. 0.5 is a coin toss.

detectable_change.note: Spread is the 10th-to-90th percentile range of one lake's usable in-season readings in one season (seasons with 6 or more). Repeat noise is two readings of one lake on one date.

gaps.note: Gaps are counted inside 1 May-30 September of each season with images, season edges included. Seasons with no images at all (2022) are not counted as gaps.
